title: onagra elata
intro: Onagra elata, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a perennial flowering plant native to North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of conditions such as eczema and arthritis. The health benefits of Onagra elata are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Onagra elata include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), a polyunsaturated fatty acid with anti-inflammatory and immune-modulating effects.
